operations.notes: The protected Web Client may call this exact named GET after the first applyAuthorEdit acknowledgement is absent. It uses the client-first idempotency key plus the original challenge nonce only as a protected header, never as a URL or response value. Committed reuses the exact Receipt-backed response-v2 settlement; Rejected requires an expired unconsumed challenge under the arbiter locks; RequiresReconfirmation is the terminal no-Receipt settlement for an expired, binding-changed, or unrecoverable open Admission; StillUnknown grants no retry or success and is not the durable Admission outcome_unknown condition. The route is not applyAuthorEdit.settlement_query and creates no Admission, Command, idempotency record, or nonce. When the Query observes a clean open Admission, the Server may complete the already-admitted direct_editor_action or append RequiresReconfirmation.
